evaluate.expression: (() => { const shell=document.querySelector('[data-testid="layout-shell"]'); const nav=document.querySelector('[data-rcl-app-shell-sidebar]'); const menu=document.querySelector('[data-testid="layout-shell-menu"]'); const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-rcl-app-shell-link]')]; const rect=n=>{const r=n.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,width:r.width,height:r.height}}; const root=document.documentElement; const priorTop=root.style.getPropertyValue('--safe-area-inset-top'),priorBottom=root.style.getPropertyValue('--safe-area-inset-bottom'); let safeArea; try {root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top','44px');root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-bottom','34px'); const header=document.querySelector('[data-rcl-app-shell-header]'),main=document.querySelector('[data-rcl-app-shell-main]'); const sr=shell.getBoundingClientRect(),hr=header.getBoundingClientRect(),bottom=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(main).paddingBottom); if(sr.top<44||hr.top<44||sr.bottom>innerHeight+1||main.getBoundingClientRect().bottom>document.querySelector('[data-rcl-app-shell-tabs]').getBoundingClientRect().top+1||parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-rcl-app-shell-tabs] nav')).paddingBottom)<34)throw new Error('Safe areas must protect header and main without viewport overflow: '+JSON.stringify({shellTop:sr.top,headerTop:hr.top,shellBottom:sr.bottom,viewport:innerHeight,bottomPadding:bottom}));safeArea={top:44,bottom:34,shellTop:sr.top,headerTop:hr.top,shellBottom:sr.bottom,bottomPadding:bottom};}finally{if(priorTop)root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top',priorTop);else root.style.removeProperty('--safe-area-inset-top');if(priorBottom)root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-bottom',priorBottom);else root.style.removeProperty('--safe-area-inset-bottom');}const result={safeArea,viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},body:{clientWidth:document.body.clientWidth,scrollWidth:document.body.scrollWidth},document:{clientWidth:document.documentElement.clientWidth,scrollWidth:document.documentElement.scrollWidth},shell:shell?rect(shell):null,menu:menu?rect(menu):null,nav:nav?rect(nav):null,destinations:links.map(link=>({testId:link.dataset.testid,href:link.getAttribute('href'),current:link.getAttribute('aria-current'),rect:rect(link)}))}; document.activeElement?.blur(); return result; })()
